issues.on_page: Donations 3,000 (under Other Financing Sources, p4); 'Grants and donations' 3,000 counted in Total revenues 1,331,797 on the General Fund budget schedule (p8); 'Operating Grants and Contributions' 3,000 on the Statement of Activities (p2)
issues.issue: A donation is revenue, not other financing. Under the extractor rules (outside_printed_total) a revenue line printed below the statement's total should be a receipts item, category donations/contributions, with outside_printed_total: true, leaving reported_totals as printed. It is also inconsistent with detail, which records the same 3,000 as revenue (donations/contributions).

The General Fund combining schedule (p11) prints this 11,072 on the Streets column's 'Property taxes' row, and the p4 Property taxes 660,967 includes it. A road tax levy is more likely property tax than 'other taxes'.

issues.on_page: Charges for services 40,899 = Pool 30,049 + Cemetery 10,850 (p11 department columns)
issues.issue: 73% of the line is pool revenue. Under the user's 2026-10-28 rule (Recreation Fees and Cemetery Fees moved out of charges for services; more than half -> that category) this could be Recreation Fees, or a split if the p11 columns count as the report's own breakdown. The same applies to detail[12].

issues.on_page: Intergovernmental 268,271 (p8 breakdown includes Homestead exemption 43,367, Motor vehicle fees 12,382)
issues.issue: The line contains homestead exemption money, which the user's rules keep out of state aid. The p8 breakdown (266,757) doesn't tie to the General Fund's 268,239, so a clean split isn't possible. The line carries no review note saying so.

A combined salaries-and-benefits line is normally Salaries and Wages, the cost-type rule's category for personnel, and detail records the same 64,950 'Personnel expenses' (p10) as Salaries and Wages. The categories are inconsistent.

issues.on_page: Cemetery column 17,460; p4 Culture and recreation 257,477 = Park + Pool + Library + Cemetery
issues.issue: The report counts Cemetery in culture and recreation, so the detail function split doesn't tie to the p4 function lines. health/welfare matches the generic rules, so this is a judgment call.
The label has a parenthetical not printed on the page. disbursements[13] ('Other miscellaneous (operating expenses)') has the same problem.
